name: Allas Live
heading: Accessibility and Special Requirements
passage: Is Allas Live accessible? Allas Live is accessible. The outdoor venue includes wooden decked pathways that are easy to move along. However, most of the ground surface is sand and grass, so please take this into account in advance. A dedicated area is reserved for wheelchair users, and we recommend that guests using rollators stay close to this area. There is an accessible viewing platform at the venue, and an accessible toilet is located nearby. If your mobility aid needs electricity or you have other special requirements during the concert, please contact production@allaslive.fi well in advance. Personal assistants can attend concerts free of charge, but they must have a companion ticket. The companion ticket can be redeemed when purchasing the ticket. How do accessible taxi drop-off and accessible parking work? An accessible taxi can stop near the Allas Live area. There is no dedicated accessible parking at the venue. More information about parking options in Katajanokka can be found on the City of Helsinki website. Are there seats at the concert? Regular Allas Live concert tickets are standing tickets and do not include a reserved seat. Unfortunately, we cannot guarantee or reserve a seat in advance. We recommend arriving at the venue in good time.

name: Allstate Arena
heading: ACCESSIBILITY
passage: Accessible/Disabled seating is available on the lower level of the arena. Wheelchair area is located behind sections 113 and 116 (depending on event set-up behind sections 105 and 108 may also be available). Wheelchairs must purchase a ticket to these areas only. There is no access to main floor or other seating areas. If you can walk with assistance tickets can be purchased in any section but wheelchair can’t be stored at or near your seat. Tickets for accessible seating areas are available through Ticketmaster and the Allstate Arena Box Office. When ordering tickets for an accessible seating area, it is important to indicate that you require accessible seating so we can properly seat you. Please note that the number of seats available in the accessible seating area meets the requirements of the Americans With Disabilities Act (ADA) and other laws relating to accessibility, however, the number of seats in the accessible seating areas is limited. Tickets for seats in the accessible seating areas are sold on a first come, first served basis.

name: Anfiteatro degli Scavi
heading: Is the itinerary accessible for people with disabilities?
passage: Yes. In December 2016, the Archaeological Park opened ‘Pompeii for All’, an itinerary specifically designed for disabled visitors to Italy’s longest accessible pathway through an archaeological site.

name: Anfiteatro degli Scavi
heading: Pompeii digital magazine. While excavation is in progress, information is already going online
passage: "The internet is changing the way we live, and archaeology cannot escape this transformation," says Director Zuchtriegel, "now our task is to manage the digital transformation proactively in order to develop its enormous potential. Through the E-Journal and our platform open.pompeiisites.org, we can achieve a level of data accessibility that was unimaginable in the past, and we can share data almost in real time. All this will change the way of doing archaeology: we are moving towards a model of collective and connective knowledge, supported in the future by Artificial Intelligence tools, which, as the Minister of Culture, Gennaro Sangiuliano, said, must be granted and mastered. Pompeii confirms itself at the forefront of 21st century archaeology."

name: Anfiteatro degli Scavi
heading: Visitor services
passage: LUGGAGE STORAGE Luggage storage services are available for a fee at the Porta Marina and Piazza Anfiteatro entrances. Visitors and all interested parties (schools, tour operators, tour guides, etc.) are informed that, to protect the frescoes and the interiors of the archaeological areas under the jurisdiction of this Archaeological Park and to ensure everyone’s safety, effective January 15, 2015, it is NOT PERMITTED to bring bags, backpacks, luggage, or cases larger than 30x30x15 cm into the excavations of Pompeii, Oplontis, Stabiae, and the Boscoreale Antiquarium.

name: Anfiteatro degli Scavi
heading: Visitor services
passage: There are three Baby Changing Facilities in three locations of the ancient city: in Via dell’Abbondanza, Via di Nola, and at the corner of Via Stabiana and Via della Fortuna. These facilities, like other services and facilities offered by the Archaeological Park, aim at granting visitors a more comfortable visit and meeting their needs. Another such example is the ‘Pompeii for All’ project with accessible and barrier-free paths providing improved access to the site to parents with buggies and mobility-impaired people.

In addition, separate permits are required for candles, open flames, pyrotechnics, vehicle displays, and trade show booths. Contractors/vendors are required to review current Fire Marshal regulations and restrictions for any items being brought in or built on the show floor. Additionally, all current ADA guidelines must be reviewed and followed for both seeing and mobility-impaired persons. Encore Global Productions can assist with creating and submitting the required diagrams and forms for an additional fee and must be requested no later than sixty (60) days in advance. If a third party contractor/vendor is submitting diagrams on the Group’s behalf, please contact your Encore Representative or Event Manager for additional details and information needed for submission. name: King Baudouin Stadium
heading: Visites
passage: Plongez dans les entrailles du Stade à la découverte de son histoire riche d’innombrables exploits sportifs, de concerts mythiques et de shows spectaculaires. Le temps d’une visite, glissez-vous dans la peau de Kevin De Bruyne, d’Usain Bolt ou de Beyoncé et vivez l’expérience Stade Roi Baudouin depuis les backstage . Découvrez les salles de presse, le vestiaire des Diables Rouges, une loge d’artiste, le tunnel des joueurs, en vous laissant conter multitude d’anecdotes par nos guides spécialisés. Au bord du terrain, ressentez l’émotion d’un joueur foulant la pelouse pour la première fois, frissonnez en revivant les records mondiaux établis sur la piste d’athlétisme, vibrez en imaginant les gradins se remplir et reprendre vos chansons à l’unisson. Une immersion complète dans les coulisses du Stade Roi Baudouin et ses espaces insolites qui restera, à coup sûr, gravée dans votre mémoire à jamais.

name: King Baudouin Stadium
heading: Visits
passage: Journey deep into the heart of the stadium and discover its rich history of sporting exploits, legendary concerts and spectacular shows. Slip into the shoes of Kevin De Bruyne, Usain Bolt or Beyoncé and experience the King Baudouin Stadium from backstage . Discover the press area, the Red Devil’s dressing room, an artist’s dressing room and the players’ tunnel, whilst listening to the anecdotes told by our expert guides. At the edge of the playing field, feel the emotion of a player stepping out onto the pitch for the first time, embrace the excitement as you relive the world records set on the athletics track and experience the thrill as you imagine crowds filling the stands and singing your songs together with fellow spectators. A complete behind-the-scenes tour of the King Baudouin Stadium and its restricted-access areas will leave you memories that will last a lifetime.

name: King Baudouin Stadium
heading: Bezoeken
passage: Duik in de onderbuik van het stadion en ontdek de rijke geschiedenis van de vele sportprestaties, legendarische concerten en spectaculaire shows. Kruip in de huid van Kevin De Bruyne, Usain Bolt of Beyoncé en beleef het Koning Boudewijnstadion van achter de schermen . Ontdek de persruimten, de kleedkamer van de Rode Duivels, een artiestenloge en de spelerstunnel, en luister naar vele anekdotes van onze deskundige gidsen. Voel de emotie van een speler die voor het eerst het veld betreedt, herbeleef de wereldrecords die op de atletiekpiste werden neergezet en stel je voor hoe de tribunes volstromen en jouw liedjes uit volle borst meezingen. Een echte onderdompeling achter de schermen van het Koning Boudewijnstadion en zijn ongewone plekjes, die je gegarandeerd voor altijd bijblijft.

passage: Security Employees and third-part contracted partners of Mohegan Arena at Casey Plaza reserve the right to inspect and search all guests entering the Arena. Guests entering the Arena for an event must enter through the West or East Gate, where guests will walk pass through outdoor metal detectors or may request a manual pat-down as warranted. Media personnel must enter through a designated press entrance at the West Gate. Security Reminders: Walk-through metal detectors will be in place at every arena entrance. No outside food or beverage is permitted inside the venue (exceptions may be made for medical/dietary restrictions). Guests are asked to have their keys, wallets and phones out of their pockets upon arrival at the security checkpoints and jackets should be unzipped. Strollers/car seats are not permitted. name: Rate Field
heading: Re-entry Policy
passage: Once a guest exits the ballpark, they may not return.

name: Rate Field
heading: Accessible Parking
passage: Designated ADA parking is available in Lot C, Lot E & Premium Lot B for cars displaying state-issued disability placards or license plates. Fans in need of assistance will be allowed by ballpark personnel to be dropped off and/or picked up in Lot B. Fans will have access to Lot B and Gate C via 33rd Street. To reach Lot B or C guests from the north should travel south on Wentworth from 31st Street and turn right on 33rd, then left on Wells Street. Guests coming from the south should travel north on LaSalle from 35th and turn left onto 33rd, then left onto Wells.

name: Rate Field
heading: Champions Monument Plaza
passage: Champions Plaza and the Champions Moment Monument, located outside Gate 4, celebrates the 2005 World Series Champion White Sox and our fans. The diamond-shaped plaza consists of a limited number of bricks inscribed with personalized fan messages (Bricks are no longer available for purchase) , surrounded by engraved pavers commemorating great moments and players in White Sox history. The granite and bronze sculpture that stands at the heart of the plaza depicts and highlights key plays, players and moments of the team's amazing march through October of the Championship 2005 season. The plaza and sculpture were unveiled in April 2008.

name: Rate Field
heading: Promotional Item Guidelines
passage: Guests must collect promotional items at their respective gate of entry. Once inside the ballpark, guests are not permitted to go to another gate to receive a promotional item, nor may guests return to the item distribution area after entering the ballpark. While every effort is made to distribute promotional items based on expected entry volume at each gate, gates may run out of items at different times.

name: Rate Field
heading: Promotional Item Guidelines
passage: Sized items cannot be exchanged after clearing the distribution area. Only one (1) item may be received per person, not per ticket. If you have purchased multiple tickets, you must exit the ballpark after receiving your giveaway item and re-enter the ballpark to receive an additional item with a new scanned ticket.

name: Rate Field

passage: Fans are encouraged to take a rideshare service to Rate Field. The Rideshare Lot is located in Lot A on the Wentworth Avenue side for pick-up and drop-off. The lot will be open until one hour after the conclusion of home games. Fans arriving by a rideshare service should enter and exit the ballpark through Gate 5.

You may receive this message if you recently reset your MLB password, but did not update the stored login information, or if you don't have an active subscription.

Re-enter your MLB account email and password (or create a new account), then connect your purchase by tapping on "Connect purchase to MLB."

Please be aware that our escort staff will not remain with you during the event, nor will they allow you to remain in our wheelchair for the duration of the event. Guest Attendants will assist guests who wish to transfer to a seat from their personal wheelchair with storing of their wheelchair during the show.

heading: Can I bring a flag to a Belfast Giants game?
passage: We are aware that visitors to the arena like to display flags and banners during Belfast Giants games, and the arena will always be as accommodating as possible. Flags and banners will not be generally confiscated; however, the obstruction of gangways, access routes, exits and entrances, health and safety signage and stairways is strictly forbidden at all times. In the event of an emergency, all access and exit points must remain clear. The arena reserves the right to confiscate flags if they are very large or may compromise public safety, obscure someone’s view, a camera position or if a flag carries offensive, discriminatory or inflammatory messaging.

name: Stanford Stadium
heading: Bag Policy & Bag Drop
passage: Stanford Athletics has implemented a Clear Bag Policy for all athletics events. This policy limits the size and types of bags that are permitted inside athletic venues. Approved bags include clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags that do not exceed 12”x6”x12” and small clutch bags or purses no larger than 4.5” x 6.5” (approximately the size of a hand with or without a handle or a strap. Click here to learn more about the Clear Bag Policy. Fans can leave their bags at designated Bag Drop locations around the facility, located at Sunken Diamond and at the north end of Stanford Stadium near Gate 10. Bag Drop locations open 30 minutes before gates open at Stanford Stadium, and will remain open until 1 hour after the game concludes.

name: State Farm Stadium
heading: ADA / Accessibility
passage: State Farm Stadium provides open captioning service for the stadium public address system. Open captioning is displayed below the stadium’s North and South video boards. Open captioning is automatically provided for larger sporting events that utilize the stadium’s public address system including Arizona Cardinals games and the Fiesta Bowl. In addition, open captioning is available via smartphones which are available free of charge at the Gate 1 Guest Services Office located across from Section 104. For more information in advance of a Cardinals game day, please contact the Cardinals Ticket Office at (602) 379-0102 or by e-mail at askquestions@cardinals.nfl.net . For smaller sporting events that utilize the public address system open captioning is available by request. To request open captioning, or to consult with stadium staff about appropriate communication aids/services, please contact our Guest Services Department at 623-433-7015 or email guestservices@statefarmstadium.com . Requests for open captioning should be made a minimum of two (2) weeks prior to the event.

Fans will be asked to leave a valid driver’s license or another form of identification when checking out an open caption smartphone. For more information in advance of Cardinals game days, please contact the Cardinals Ticket Office at 602-379-0102 or via e-mail at askquestions@cardinals.nfl.net . name: Target Field
heading: Entry Guidelines
passage: Prohibited Items: For the general safety of all guests the following items are not allowed into Target Field: ball retrievers, balloons, bats, beach balls, boom boxes, brooms, fireworks, flasks, Frisbees, coolers, inflatables, laser pointers, lawn chairs, noise-making devices, weapons, wooden sticks, or rods. Small whiskbrooms and small souvenir bats are permitted. Prior to entering the ballpark, guests will have the option of: surrendering the item at the gate, leaving and then returning without the prohibited item, or storing the item in a locker outside Gate 6. Surrendered items will not be returned to guests.

name: Target Field
heading: Bag Storage
passage: Prohibited bags may be securely stored at no charge during Twins home games. The bag storage area is located near Gate 6 and Target Field Station. Please note, all bags will be searched prior to being stored.

name: Target Field
heading: Bicycle Parking
passage: The Minnesota Twins encourage guests to ride their bicycle to Target Field. There is a secure, staffed bike corral located near Gate 6 and Target Field Station, and guests are encouraged to store their bike in this area. There is no charge for this service. For more information, visit twins.com/transportation .

name: Target Field
heading: MyTwins Season Ticket Member Entrances
passage: MyTwins Reserved, Choice, and Flex Season Ticket Members and their guests have access to two exclusive entrances, located at Gate 34 and Target Field Station. Present your digital MyTwins Membership digital ID card and skip the lines to gain quicker access to Target Field.

name: Target Field
heading: Concessions
passage: There are three restaurants located at Target Field. Hrbek’s is in the home-plate area of the Main Concourse, near Gate 14 and Section 114. Truly On Deck is in the right-field corner area of the Club Concourse, near Gate 34. The Keeper’s Heart Town Ball Tavern is located in the left-field corner area of the Club Concourse, between Section V and Section 229. All 3 of these restaurants are open to all guests and are fully wheelchair accessible.

name: Target Field
heading: ATMs and Reverse ATM’s
passage: Target Field has one traditional U.S. Bank ATM located on the Main Concourse in the elevator lobby near Section 112. Please note, concessions and retail locations at Target Field do not accept cash. Target Field also has five reverse ATM’s, which can be used to load cash onto pre-paid debit cards. These are located on the Main Concourse inside Gate 29 and in the elevator lobby near Gate 3; on the Treasure Island Home Run Deck near Section 231; and on the Terrace Concourse near the top of both the Right Field and Left Field escalators. There is no transaction fee to use the reverse ATM’s.

name: Target Field
heading: Carbliss Clubhouse
passage: The Carbliss Clubhouse is a lounge located in the left field corner at Target Field, near section 127 and Gate 6. The Carbliss Clubhouse has several monitors so guests can follow the Twins and other Major League Baseball games. The lounge has tiered standing-room drink rails facing the field, several high-top tables, and a cabana-style seating area. The entire area also featuees overhead radiant heaters.

name: Target Field
heading: Drop-Off Zone
passage: Guests with limited mobility may use either of the Drop Off Zones along 7th Street, near both the New Era Team Store and Gate 14. No accessible parking permit is required to use these Drop-Off Zones, but these are strictly drop off zones with no parking permitted in either zone.

name: Target Field
heading: Elevators
passage: There are 13 public elevators located throughout Target Field. Elevators 1 & 2 are in the Administrative Office building near Gate 6. Elevators 3 & 4 are located across from Section 125. Elevators 6 & 7 are located across from Section 112. Elevators 9-12 are located across from Section 103. Elevator 13 is located across from Section 133, and elevator 14 is located at Gate 3. Elevator T1 is located near the entrance to Truly On Deck.

name: Target Field
heading: Aerosols and Self-Defense Sprays
passage: Aerosols and Self-Defense Sprays may not be carried into Target Field. These items may be stored for free at any entry gate and picked-up at that same gate upon leaving Target Field.

name: Utilita Arena Birmingham
heading: Venue App
passage: Is there an official venue app? Yes! The official Utilita Arena Birmingham app is now available on the App Store and Google Play. It is currently being rolled out for selected events to help you manage tickets and plan your visit. If you have been contacted by your ticket agent and advised to download the venue app, please visit our Venue App Guide for a full walkthrough on how to set up your account and access your tickets. How do I know if the venue app is available for my event? If the app is active for your show, you will receive an email before your visit with specific instructions. You can also check the dedicated event page on our website; if the event is mobile-only via the app, it will be clearly stated there. How do I access my tickets in the venue app? To view your tickets, simply download the app and create an account using the exact same email address you used to purchase your tickets. Once logged in, tap 'Retrieve My Tickets' and link your AXS account. Email Match: If you used a different email address by mistake, please delete the app account and re-register with the correct one. Troubleshooting: If your tickets still don't appear, you can access them via the AXS app, contact AXS Support for assistance. or visit the venue Box Office on the night with your order confirmation and photo ID. Please note that a £2.00 fee per ticket will apply for this service. For a step-by-step visual guide, please visit our Venue App Guide .

name: Newport Folk Festival
heading: How a Boston Club Birthed the Newport Jazz Festival in 1954
passage: And as good as it was going, it was about to get better. One night shortly after opening, the Louis Armstrong All Stars were playing Symphony Hall and Wein tasked pianist and former member of Armstrong’s band Sidney Catlett with getting them to stop by after the gig. And stop by they did. Louis Armstrong made a dramatic impromptu entrance before jumping on stage to sing “When It’s Sleepy Time Down South.” Wein and Storyville had catapulted to a new level.

heading: WHAT IS ALLOWED?
passage: Kindness Sunscreen Empty refillable water bottles to use at refillable water stations Soft-sided coolers Bags under 20”x20”x10” Blankets 6’x8’ or smaller Strollers/wagons/carts are only allowed for patrons attending with children 9 years old and younger who must be present with you at time of entry Chairs under 34” high Chairs under 30″ high are allowed outside of the no-chair zones. Personal umbrellas in the event of rain, but must be closed during performances Point-and-shoot cameras are permitted, but cannot be used to reproduce the event and must not interfere with other fans’ enjoyment of the event. Be present! Medications and prescriptions Over the counter medications are allowed. If you bring prescription medication, please bring a valid photo ID that matches the name printed on your prescription.

heading: What’s the best way to get around?
passage: We encourage you to decorate your transportation. You may not drive your car at the event. This is a serious safety issue – moving cars create large clouds of dust, reducing visibility dramatically. Please recognize the importance of this rule. The sole exceptions for this are Mutant Vehicles and vehicles for people with accessibility needs. If you would like to bring your Mutant Vehicle art car to Black Rock City, see the Mutant Vehicle Licensing and Criteria . You will need to apply and then register with the Black Rock City DMV (Department of Mutant Vehicles) dmv@burningman.com . If you have a accessibility need and need a vehicle to get around Black Rock City, see the Vehicles for people with accessibility needs page. For more information read through the Vehicles at Burning Man section of this web site.

heading: Accessibility (ADA)
passage: Should a patron need to exchange their seating for wheelchair and companion seating on the day of the game they are attending, they may do so, subject to availability, at the Saints ticket box office at Gate A Ground. Please be advised such exchanges and relocations are accommodated on a first come, first served basis. If seating is available for an exchange, a comparable seating location will be offered. passage: The iTHINK Financial Amphitheatre, formerly known as Coral Sky Amphitheatre, Cruzan Amphitheatre, and Perfect Vodka Amphitheatre, is a modern open-air venue owned by the South Florida Fair & Palm Beach County Expositions, Inc., and operated by Live Nation. Since its inception in 1996, it has been a cornerstone of South Florida’s live music scene, hosting genres from rock to country and festivals like Lilith Fair and Crüe Fest. Located at the South Florida Fairgrounds, the venue offers a capacity of 20,000, with 8,000 reserved seats under a roof and a sprawling lawn for up to 12,000 guests. It features state-of-the-art lighting and sound systems, multiple concession stands, YETI water refill stations, and recycling bins to promote sustainability. The venue is cashless, accepting only credit, debit, or mobile payments like Apple Pay and Google Pay. Accessibility is a priority, with ADA-compliant seating, restrooms, and parking, plus assisted listening devices available upon request. Guests can access two main entrances (North and South Gates), a Fast Lane gate for passholders, and a VIP entry for VIP clients. passage: TO Live is committed to providing an access guide and pre-show audio notes for every TO Live Presents performance. Many TO Live Presents events will also incorporate additional access measures at select performances, including audio description, ASL interpretation, captions, and relaxed performances. To learn more about the specific access measures available for TO Live Presents events, please visit the accessibility section on the individual show page or contact the box office. Occasional guest performances may incorporate additional access measures.

name: Meridian Hall
passage: TO Live is committed to welcoming persons with disabilities who are accompanied by a service animal at TO Live facilities that are open to the public and other third parties. Patron services and other TO Live staff are trained on how to interact with persons with disabilities who require the assistance of a guide dog or other service animal. Service animals can often be identified through visual indicators. For example, a guide dog might be wearing a harness or a vest with a certification badge or it may be helping a person perform tasks. If a service animal cannot be identified easily, TO Live staff may request that the person with the animal provide documentation from a regulated health professional to confirm that the animal is required for reasons relating to their disability. To make appropriate seating arrangements, contact the box office when purchasing tickets by phone at 416-366-7723 or 1-800-708-6754 during regular business hours (Monday to Friday, 1 pm to 6 pm), or by email at boxoffice@tolive.com .

name: Meridian Hall
passage: TO Live is committed to welcoming persons with disabilities who are accompanied by a support person. Patron services and other TO Live staff are trained on how to interact with persons with disabilities who require the assistance of a support person. Any person with a disability who is accompanied by a support person will be allowed to access TO Live premises that are open to the public and other third parties. At no time will a person with a disability who is accompanied by a support person be prevented from having access to their support person while on the premises. For ticketed performances or events, each person attending, including support persons, must have a valid ticket for that performance or event. We are happy to offer free admission to support persons for patrons with access needs at all TO Live Presents events. Other events may charge full admission price for support persons. For specific accessible seating requests or accommodation requests to ensure seating with an accompanying support person, patrons are requested to make accommodation requests with venue box office ticket sales staff at the time of ticket purchase by phone at 416-366-7723 or 1-800-708-6754 during regular business hours (Monday to Friday, 1 pm to 6 pm), or by email at boxoffice@tolive.com . TO Live makes every effort to meet specific seating and accommodation requests for patrons with disabilities and accompanying support persons.

name: Meridian Hall
passage: TO Live will provide notice in the event of a planned or unexpected disruption of accessible services or facilities usually used by persons with disabilities. This notice will include information about the reason for the disruption, its anticipated duration, and a description of alternative facilities or services, if available. Notice of disruption of accessible services or facilities will be posted at the location of the disruption, at the front entrance of the affected facility, and where appropriate for the current disruption (for example, service counters, box office ticket sales, communication with patrons who have made accommodation requests). For lengthy and planned delays, notice will also be posted on this page.
